title: Russian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew originating from Russia, made with earthy lentils and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 8 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, broth, flour, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lentils are tender, about 30-40 minutes.
Season the stew with additional salt and pepper if needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
